bounded_evaluation_proposal.cohorts: Approximately48 training and48 independent held-out imports, split into smaller native runs if required by capture bounds. Exact counts are planning limits, not claimed observations.
mandatory_success_partition: All16 positive modes once, preserving distinct sentinel coefficients/table data when switching modes.
Zero, negative and unrecognized positive selectors; repeat after populated state to detect unwanted clears.
Mode6 selectors0/1/2/3 and out-of-range for each of its two independent tables, including asymmetric selections.
Modes13/15 with axis values2,3 (sum5/product6), fractional finite coordinates whose truncations remain bounded, and zero/one derived vectors with no corresponding input rows.
Mode16 widths1/2/3 and normalized nonpositive width, asymmetric rank3 counts; compare physical extents before header completion and after payload.
mandatory_failure_partition: Outer header EOF and whitespace-only line, plus partial initialized header accepted as native0/selected mode.
Real4/real5/real7 matching-zero and partial assignments, signedzero, no finalLF and physicalEOF.
Mode9 first helper failure followed by second success, and first success followed by second failure.
Mode10 seventh value consumed but not persisted.
Modes2/3 and7/8 count-header failure versus axis/dependent EOF; verify conditional flag timing.
Mode6 failure at first local header, first payload, second local header and second payload.
Modes13/15 count failure, first table axis/dependent EOF, derived first-vector EOF and final-vector EOF; later tables must retain prior allocations until reached.
Mode16 width-header failure, count-header failure, axis EOF and staged-dependent EOF; no read of unassigned malloc scratch.
lifecycle_and_integration: Both2D and3D roots; same-dimension retention versus changed-dimension destruction and recreation.
Existing active mesh, inactive object and material creation after populated objects; FSTRES has no explicit eager post-payload refresh.
Full FSTRES state survives unrelated material-name/reference/relation edits and remains independent of selected GRNDAT state.
bounded_evaluation_proposal.negative_testing: Mutate field values, physical capacities, type defaults, helper statuses, flag sequencing, derived vector widths, source bindings and input ordering in the independent verifier. Prove each corruption is rejected; report any unexercised check honestly.

Nonfinite or out-of-int32 axis conversion, signed sum/product overflow, unsafe negative allocation sizes.
Any probe read inferred solely from live logical width rather than observed allocation extent.
